inputs.prompt: A charming flat 2D cartoon animation for young children. Preserve the exact input train and all its parts. The locomotive faces left. Its steam chimney is the TALL YELLOW STACK with the broad flared top on the LEFT/front of the blue boiler, above the orange front wheel (top center approximately 30% image width, 15% image height). Emit one small soft white, black-outlined steam cloud ONLY from the TOP CENTER of this tall chimney. Show the cloud first touching the chimney top, then rising vertically clear of the rim before drifting gently right and fading. The SHORT ROUNDED YELLOW DOME to its RIGHT, between chimney and red cab (approximately 44% width, 32% height), stays solid, unchanged and completely inactive: no steam, smoke, bubbles or puffs above that dome. Do not relocate, shorten, reshape or add outlets. The toy train rolls slowly a short distance and its wheels turn gently. Preserve exact proportions, bright solid colors and thick black outlines. Keep the entire train and steam visible. Locked camera, plain white background, gentle smooth readable motion, no cuts, no zoom, no text, no new objects except the specified steam. Let steam dissipate and end near the starting pose. No speech, eyes, mouths, faces, limbs or character features.
